Startled by the sudden cheering, I looked toward the stands and saw
a group holding up placards that read "Daring Heart."

I appreciate the invitation.
...But judging from how glamorous it sounds today, I'd definitely feel out of place.

If anything, Daring Heart is the type who gets fired up by cheers.
Having an environment closer to the real thing was a welcome bonus.

The theme this time is "Spies," so...
we're dressing up as secret agents and bodyguards. What do you think?

Hey, buddy!
We're not eating in the cafeteria today!

No need to worry, I'll be right beside you!
—Yes or Hell Yes?

Hehe!
Just changing the scenery makes it quite fun, don't you think?

I see.
...In that case, participation is okay!

Yes.
Hehe, aren't they wonderful?
Don't you think so?

Actually, I'm invited to an acquaintance's garden party tomorrow.
...If you'd like, why don't you come along?

To make that happen, I want to spend more time with you.
I want us to share all kinds of new experiences.

Yes! This time it's a "theme party."
We dress up and play games matching the host's chosen theme.
So, may I ask you to be my escort?

—Thank you for cheering for me!
I won't let your cheers go to waste♪

I wanted to consult you about this afternoon's training. Remember,
we talked about stepping up the intensity and extending the time for the race?

No way!
In that case, I'll put in even more spirit.
Whew~♪

Asked out of the blue, I tilted my head. I had no particular plans for tomorrow,
and had intended to look over documents at home, but...

One day during lunch break.
While eating lunch in the Trainer's office while reviewing documents...

You get tired of just the dorm and cafeteria every day!
...Though the food was made by the staff, of course!

Really? Thanks!
Alright, I'll let them know!

You see, we're not all in the same dorm, right?
So think of this as our regular joint dinner party!

Got it!
...By the way. What are your plans for tomorrow?

I need to know more about you,
and you need to know more about me.

So my friends said they wanted to come cheer me on after their own training.
It might get a little noisy—is that okay with you?

D-A-R-I-N-G! Heart!
D-A-R-I-N-G! Heart! Wooo!

—All riiiight!
Let's have a happy dinner tiiiime☆

Oh my! Having lunch with your work again?
You two are so lovey-dovey it makes me jealous.

...Phew~.
Just because tomorrow's a rest day, I ended up cramming too much into the routine.

She lived in a world so entirely different from my usually quiet life.
...Unaccustomed to such scenes, I wanted to avoid causing any trouble.

After all, we're buddies who are going to
sprint through the Twinkle Series together, aren't we?

—Well, we'll be heading back first.
Trainer, thank you so much for today!
And after that, it was decided that Daring Heart and everyone who came to cheer would have dinner together—however.

Phew... I'm all set!
Shall we get started?
